subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: The frog said to the boys crying, "Don't throw stone on us." The boys said, "We are playing and making fun." "What is playing to you is death to us, we are dying," said the frog. The boys said, "We are regretful for our deed, please forgive us."
guide_solution: The frog requested the boys crying not to throw stone on them (f). The boys said that they (b) were playing and making fun. The frog said what is playing to the boys is death to the frogs. It added that they (f) were dying. The boys expressed regret for their deed and asked for forgiveness.
